newsitem.title: USA: Taiwan seeks 85,000-86,000 T U.S. wheat - trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seeks 85,000-86,000 T U.S. wheat - trade.

text.p: Taiwan will tender this Thursday for about 85,000 to 86,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for January-February delivery, several U.S. exporters said.

"They will be in this Thursday for Friday reply," a U.S. exporter said. He said the deal included 15,800 tonnes of U.S. dark northern spring wheat and 10,200 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat slated for January 20-February 10 shipment.
Another 16,000 tonnes of U.S. DNS wheat, 9,400 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat and 8,600 tonnes of U.S. western white wheat was set for January 31-February 20.
Also, 16,500 tonnes of U.S. DNS wheat, 6,400 tonnes of HRW wheat and 3,100 tonnes of western white wheat was due for January 31-February 15, he said.

Another U.S. exporter said the total was about 85,000 tonnes, out of which 50,000 tonnes was U.S. DNS wheat, 25,000 tonnes U.S. HRW wheat and 10,000 tonnes of U.S. white wheat for January 20 through February 20 shipment.
